rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name + zip and worked on the correct account and orders. It successfully: (1) changed the shipping address of the pending watch order to the New York address from another order, (2) modified one silicone-strap watch to a metal variant with white dial, and (3) handled the air purifier request properly by declining an exchange on a non-delivered order, then seeking confirmation and modifying the pending order to the large/HEPA/night mode variant with correct pricing implications. However, the agent failed to obtain explicit confirmation before two order-changing writes: the watch order address update and the watch variant change. Policy requires stating the exact change and getting explicit approval before any write. While the final information and actions were otherwise accurate and within policy, the missing confirmations constitute a policy violation, so the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
